Delhi Gymkhana Club Faces Eviction Notice, Legal Battle Ensues

The Delhi Gymkhana Club is facing a potential eviction following a notice from the central government. Members have approached the Delhi High Court challenging the government's action. The court is expected to clarify its stance on the matter soon.
